mmglockenspiel.name: Marienplatz Glockenspiel
mmglockenspiel.slogan: Thirty-two figures, one tournament, every day at eleven.
mmglockenspiel.line: Its chime became operational on 18 February 1909; the knights' joust recalls the 1568 wedding of Duke William V.

mmteufelstritt.name: Frauenkirche
mmteufelstritt.slogan: Two onion domes and a devil's footprint by the door.
mmteufelstritt.line: No building in Munich may be taller than its towers, which rise 98.57 m and 98.45 m.

mvnymphenburg.name: Nymphenburg Palace
mvnymphenburg.slogan: A summer palace where kings were born and beauties were hung.
mvnymphenburg.line: Begun in 1664, it is where Ludwig II was born in 1845; Ludwig I's gallery holds 36 portraits of Munich beauties.

mvzugspitze.name: Zugspitze
mvzugspitze.slogan: Germany's roof, one cable car ride from the Alpine foothills.
mvzugspitze.line: At 2,962 m it is Germany's highest peak, first climbed on 27 August 1820 by Josef Naus.

mvlinderhof.name: Linderhof Palace
mvlinderhof.slogan: Ludwig II's small, glittering retreat in the Ammergau Alps.
mvlinderhof.line: The smallest of Ludwig II's palaces is the only one finished in his lifetime; its Venus Grotto had an electric power plant by 1878.
